mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user_stats (user_id, qq_number, total_signin_days, continuous_signin_days, max_continuous_days, last_signin_date, love_signin_days, love_continuous_days) VALUES (#{userId}, #{qqNumber}, #{totalSigninDays}, #{continuousSigninDays}, #{maxContinuousDays}, #{lastSigninDate}, #{loveSigninDays}, #{loveContinuousDays})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user_stats SET total_signin_days = #{totalSigninDays}, continuous_signin_days = #{continuousSigninDays}, max_continuous_days = #{maxContinuousDays}, last_signin_date = #{lastSigninDate}, love_signin_days = #{loveSigninDays}, love_continuous_days = #{loveContinuousDays}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE app_user_stats SET total_signin_days = total_signin_days + 1, continuous_signin_days = continuous_signin_days + 1, max_continuous_days = CASE WHEN continuous_signin_days + 1 > max_continuous_days THEN continuous_signin_days + 1 ELSE max_continuous_days END, last_signin_date = CURDATE(), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE app_user_stats SET love_signin_days = love_signin_days + 1, love_continuous_days = love_continuous_days + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
